description: This file defines a PHP class `NyholmPsr17Factory` in the Slim framework, specifically extending `Psr17Factory`. It is responsible for creating server request objects using the Nyholm PSR-7 implementation, providing a factory method `getServerRequestCreator` that returns a `ServerRequestCreator` configured with specific NYHOLM classes.

classes.name: NyholmPsr17Factory
classes.description: A factory class extending Psr17Factory to create server request objects using NYHOLM's PSR-7 implementation, providing configuration for response, stream, and server request creator classes.

methods.name: getServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Returns a ServerRequestCreator instance configured with NYHOLM PSR-7 factory classes, facilitating the creation of server request objects.
